prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a lumbar back strain as the primary complaint. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of this type of crash. Over four visits, care consisted of assessment, conservative management, and gradual rehabilitation exercises. Treatment followed a typical course, with pain and muscle guarding easing steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned. Imaging and examination findings clearly support the diagnosis of soft tissue injury to the lower back. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known from the patient's history. Two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service are currently under review by the billing office. Functional status at last visit was improved, with the patient returning to most daily activities and work duties, and discharge from active care was planned with a home exercise program.
